title: 技術者のための統計
subtitle: Statistics for Engineers
courseType: Mathematics and Science ProgramMathematics and Science Courses
keywords: Evaluation of statistics based on probability theory
educationalGoal:
Students will
(1) learn data organization and processing
(2) acquire basic knowledge of probability.
(3) learn typical distribution functions such as the normal distribution,Student's t-distribution, and the chi-square distribution.
(4) learn methods for interval estimation and hypothesis testing.
(5) learn methods for multivariate analysis
advice:
This is a course in statistical analysis of data. We will cover the following topics:
1.  Data organization and data distribution
(1) Data collection and organization (2) Data distribution (3) Quantitative data distribution features
2 Relationships between variates
(1) Arrangement of bivariate data (2) Correlation and correlation coefficient (3) Estimated bivariate relationship
3. Basics of Probability Theory
(1) Basic concept of probability theory (2) Probability distribution of discrete quantity (3) Probability distribution of continuous quantity
4. Basics of statistical data processing
(1) Sampling of sample population (2) Evaluation of statistics based on probability theory (3) Statistical estimation of population parameter
5. Statistical tests and multivariate analysis
(1) Basic concept of statistical test (2) Method of statistical test (3) To multivariate analysis
6．Conduct statistical analysis using the programming language "R" with real social data
books: Textbooks：Getting Started with Data Science [kyoritsu Shuppan]

activityGoals.body: Be able to organize the data and obtain the basic features of the data.
Be able to calculate mean and variance for random variables.
Be able to analyze data by calculating the necessary statistics from data.
Be able to estimate and test population mean, variance, and population ratio using a sample distribution.
Understand the meanings of fundamental english words for statistics.
Be able to understand the contents of each class, work on assigned tasks, and attend every class.

achievementLevels.ideal:
(1) Understand how to organize the data that is the basis of data science.
(2) Understand the meaning of random variables appropriately and calculate the mean and variance of a probability distribution.
(3) Use common probability distributions to calculate probabilities in various situations.
(4) Correctly calculate the statistical values required for data analysis.
(5) Perform appropriate interval estimation and hypothesis testing using a sample distribution.
(6) Apply course contents to various statistical problems.
achievementLevels.standard:
(1) Understand how to organize the data that is the basis of data science.
(2) Understand the meaning of random variables and calculate the mean and variance of a probability distribution.
(3) Calculate probability using common probability distributions.
(4) Calculate the statistical values required for data analysis.
(5) Perform interval estimation and hypothesis testing using a sample distribution.
(6) Apply course contents to statistical problems.
